stories.title: Iran reports three tanker fires in Hormuz
stories.detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines. The report did not independently establish the vessels' identities or the extent of the damage.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov Iran time; attributed claim in the live report.
stories.caption: STRAIT OF HORMUZ  /  ARTIST'S ILLUSTRATION

stories.title: Asian chip stocks rebound
stories.detail: Chip-related shares led the rally as Tokyo reopened after a holiday and Seoul and Taipei surged.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov opening changes rounded to one decimal on the page. Nikkei and Taiex percentages are computed from the published opening value and point change.

stories.title: Singapore lifts growth outlook
stories.detail: Third-quarter GDP grew 6.1% year on year. The government now expects about 6% growth in 2026.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov, official 08:00 SGT release.

stories.title: Poland reports drone crossing
stories.detail: Military says the Russian drone crossed briefly during a strike on Ukraine.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov 00:47 CET, AFP dispatch in Le Figaro.

stories.title: Qatar pushes to reopen Iran talks
stories.detail: AP's 24 Nov dispatch details meetings with senior US officials on Monday.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov 01:27 UTC AP dispatch; talks took place 23 Nov Washington time.

stories.title: Seoul scrambles jets
stories.detail: Seoul said Russian planes entered its air defense zone. Officials corrected an earlier alert.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov in South Korea; AP initially timestamped in UTC on 23 Nov.

stories.title: Heavy rain risk in Tamil Nadu
stories.detail: Forecasters warn of heavy rain in parts of the south on Tuesday.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov active weather forecast, issued on 23 Nov.

stories.title: Extortion strains small firms

stories.date_note: 24 Nov 00:00 EAT marked by the publisher for article 2001562885.

stories.title: UN urges shared AI safeguards

stories.title: Consumer confidence holds

stories.date_note: 24 Nov UTC edition coverage on July-October performance.

stories.title: Mocoa water plant plan revived
stories.detail: The government announced a COP 62.95 billion investment to restart a wastewater project.
stories.date_note: 23 Nov local government announcement; covered by Semana at 23 Nov 19:10 COT, or 24 Nov 00:10 UTC.

stories.title: Mid-month inflation release due
stories.detail: The statistics agency is due to publish its first-half November index.
stories.date_note: 24 Nov scheduled in the official calendar.

stories.title: Six MPs file complaint over threats
stories.detail: The paper reports that six members of parliament filed a complaint over anonymous death threats.

stories.title: MPs call for air pollution warnings
stories.detail: A Commons motion calls for formal public warnings during hazardous episodes.
stories.date_note: On UK parliamentary papers as of 24 Nov, citing wildfire smoke and ozone episodes.

stories.title: Opposition weighs censure of minister
stories.detail: Opposition parties are preparing to discuss a censure motion over political fundraising events.

stories.title: Abia school collapse probe reported
stories.detail: Abia's governor ordered an inquiry after a pupil died in a collapse on Friday.

stories.title: Cholera vaccine drive due to start
stories.detail: A vaccination campaign is scheduled to start in the Republic of the Congo.

stories.title: Cyclone remnants bring rough weather

stories.title: Eskom tender rules face criticism
stories.detail: A report examines whether tender criteria keep local renewable developers from leading bids.

stories.title: Post-summit report flags climate inequality
stories.detail: An AP report examines how the breakdown could widen inequalities in climate protection.

stories.title: Heavy showers forecast in southwest
